mapper.insert: INSERT INTO claims (item_id, claimant_id, evidence) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{claimantId}, #{evidence})
mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.item_id, i.title AS item_title, i.type AS item_type, c.claimant_id, cu.name AS claimant_name, i.user_id AS owner_id, ou.name AS owner_name, c.evidence, c.status, c.reason, c.created_at, c.reviewed_at, h.id AS handover_id FROM claims c JOIN items i ON i.id = c.item_id JOIN users cu ON cu.id = c.claimant_id JOIN users ou ON ou.id = i.user_id LEFT JOIN handovers h ON h.claim_id = c.id
mapper.select: ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims c JOIN items i ON i.id = c.item_id
mapper.update: UPDATE claims SET status = #{status}, reason = #{reason}, reviewed_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
